# Cascadia Mono

The monospace UI font (Terminal, Notepad). `kernel/gdi/font_inter.c`
contains glyph bitmaps rasterized from **Cascadia Mono 2404.23**
(`ttf/static/CascadiaMono-Regular.ttf`) by Microsoft, licensed under the SIL
Open Font License 1.1 (see `LICENSE`).

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code/releases/tag/v2404.23

To regenerate, see the instructions at the top of `tools/mkfont.c`.
